title: Flock Safety ALPR Cross-Jurisdiction Surveillance Contract Lattice — Tulare and Fresno Counties
executive_summary: Flock Safety LLC operates an Automatic License Plate Reader (ALPR) surveillance network across at least three agencies in the ODIA corpus. Contracts and procurement records show: (1) City of Fresno — $1,500,000 sole-source contract (Fresno City Legistar, 64,489 findings corpus); (2) Visalia Police Department — 22 documents referencing Flock Safety with 355 associated findings, including 75 cross-entity ALPR detections flagged against SB 524 AI-transparency citation requirements; (3) Fresno County — 1 confirmed Flock Safety reference in a hex-named PDF (SHA-256 verified). This lattice establishes a regional shared-vendor surveillance infrastructure without cross-jurisdictional interoperability disclosure, without AB 481 surveillance use policy citations in all contracts, and without SB 524 AI-transparency compliance language in Fresno City and Visalia PD procurement records.
